title: A number that exactly matches one Part Library entry links to it
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • You can switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310), in the location switcher in the top bar.
  • Exactly one Part Library entry has the number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-LINK-01), with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Link Library).
  • {Part-A} is stocked at {Location-B} only, so {Location-A} stocks no part with that number.
  • The description you will type, {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL LINK TYPED LEFT), differs from {Description-A} by more than upper and lower case.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type {Description-B} in Description.
  3. Type {Part-A} in Part Number, with exactly the same characters and the same upper and lower case.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type a Cost (for example 10.00).
  6. Click Save.
  7. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  8. Go to Parts → Part Library and type {Part-A} in the search.
  9. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the window closes and a green message reads exactly "Part created. Linked to {Part-A} in the Part Library. Its description "{Description-A}" was kept." It goes away on its own.
  • Step 7: one row shows Part Number {Part-A} with Description {Description-A}, the Part Library description, not {Description-B}.
  • Step 8: still exactly one row for {Part-A}, with Description {Description-A}: no second entry was made.
  • Step 9: the entry's page lists two workplaces under Parts, {Location-B} and {Location-A}, and Total parts reads 2 (1 before + 1 new = 2).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S7-R4, S7-R5, S7-R6, S7-R9, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (Number and description typed), board 1.4 (Saved and linked to the Part Library entry), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R4: “On save, the system looks for a Part Library entry whose number is exactly the number typed, including upper and lower case.”
  • S7-R5: “If exactly one entry matches, the new part is linked to that entry.”
  • S7-R6: “A linked entry keeps its own description. The description typed in the dialog does not change it.”
  • S7-R9: “When the part was linked to an existing entry whose description differs from the one typed, ignoring upper and lower case and spaces before and after, the system shows "Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." For example: "Part created. Linked to N68SL-356 in the Part Library. Its description "BRAKE PAD" was kept."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (New part linked to an entry whose description differs): “"Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." | Success toast, fades on its own”
